description: kotodama's models for the anamnesis registry, generated by kotodama.anamnesis_registry from kotodama's own tables; name this file in ANAMNESIS_MODELS.

kotodama-tsumugi-1b.name: kotodama-tsumugi-1b
kotodama-tsumugi-1b.notes: kotodama-tsumugi 1B base: 52 unique / 72 effective layers (a 20-layer core from layer 19, run twice), AttnRes over 8 committed blocks, SmolLM2 tokenizer. A raw kotodama checkpoint: load and capture through kotodama.model.capture, never an HF cast (it would drop the routing). The sampling fields are the kotodama base law until the model has its own. Sampled layers: the rescaling rule [0, 18, 36, 45, 54, 63, 71] plus loop twins [25, 34, 56]. Tokenizer HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M; AttnRes boundaries [0, 1, 7, 9, 17, 19, 39, 59].
